title: Fork and Pull Request: Two Lanes, Seven Steps

callouts.label: Find the repository
callouts.hint: A binder with a magnifying glass, in the top lane.
callouts.description: Find the repository of the resource you want to improve. You cannot copy what you have not found.
callouts.tip: The repository is the original, and the maintainer owns it.

callouts.label: The maintainer reads and comments
callouts.hint: A person beside a speech bubble, in the top lane, with a faint dotted branch ending in a cross.
callouts.description: The maintainer reads your pull request and leaves comments. The review follows the proposal.
callouts.tip: The faint dotted branch is the other ending: a maintainer may also decline a pull request.

callouts.label: The maintainer merges
callouts.hint: A rubber stamp pressing a page with a green check, at the right end of the top lane.
callouts.description: The maintainer merges the pull request into the original. Merging is the last step, after the review is satisfied.
callouts.tip: Only now does the original change. The sequence shows the successful path.

callouts.label: Fork it to make your own copy
callouts.hint: A binder with a dotted copy of itself, in the bottom lane, at the end of the first crossing arrow.
callouts.description: Fork the repository to make your own copy. You change your copy, not the original.
callouts.tip: A fork keeps a link back to the source. It is the repository version of the revise and remix permissions.

callouts.label: Make your change and save it with a message
callouts.hint: A page with a pencil and a small note, in the bottom lane.
callouts.description: Make your change in your copy and save it with a message that says what you did. A pull request needs a change to propose.
callouts.tip: Write the message for the maintainer who will read it.

callouts.label: Open a pull request
callouts.hint: A yellow sticky note on the arrow that crosses up to the top lane.
callouts.description: Open a pull request that proposes your change to the original repository. The maintainer can only review a change that has been proposed.
callouts.tip: A pull request is a proposal. It does not change the original until it is merged.

callouts.label: You answer with more changes
callouts.hint: A page with a pencil and a small grey speech bubble, in the bottom lane.
callouts.description: You answer any comments by adding more changes to your copy. You respond to what the review found.
callouts.tip: The thin dashed arrow carries the comments back to your copy.
